overall_claim: PX4/MAVLink simulation/emulation pipeline with domain-specific empirical reference fits, recorded trajectory replay, and declared network stress profiles; C2 impairment calibration and independent end-to-end fidelity validation are not established.

domain: Dataset-32: 3.4 GHz, AERPAW Lake Wheeler, observed flights/range/altitude
layer1_propagation.claim_limit: Source-domain path-loss trend fit and grouped holdout only; the fit is not coupled into the SITL qdisc, and no absolute link budget or RF-to-C2 mapping is established.

domain: AFAR recorded GPS trajectories; pipeline-defined source-directory holdout recorded in manifest
layer2_mobility.claim_limit: P14 fits an equal-trace-weighted scalar-speed Gauss-Markov process, turn-rate reference, and median altitude profile from AFAR train groups; P7 couples seeded waypoint speeds, turn-related speed caps, and altitude profile into PX4 mission commands. Holdout JSD scores AFAR feature-distribution shift, while P13 separately scores SITL route tracking. This does not establish real-aircraft dynamics, timing fidelity, or swarm topology.

domain: Pawprints AERPAW LTE RSRP/RSRQ/RSSI and cell association
layer3_link_kpis.claim_limit: These datasets do not measure the target MAVLink C2 link; qdisc delay/loss/rate remain stress assumptions.

domain: PX4 SITL/Gazebo + MAVLink/Containernet generated runs, when executed
layer4_end_to_end_fidelity.claim_limit: No synchronized target C2 measurement/reference twin pair; generated PCAP/telemetry and IDS scores alone do not establish fidelity.

required_next_evidence: Run P8 on the manifest holdout source group, P13 for path/altitude errors, and P15 for per-quantity kinematic pilot gates; the P15 limits are within-source-group archive thresholds, not universal flight standards.
Obtain compatible synchronized C2 reference KPIs (radio configuration, MAVLink PCAP, loss, RTT/jitter, goodput) before fitting target-C2 qdisc mappings.
Validate end-to-end simulator outputs against independent compatible C2 references on predeclared trajectory, network, and telemetry metrics.
